articles.title: Teacher humour as a predictor of student emotions and motivation: the mediating role of socio-emotional and motivational factors
articles.abstract: Although prior cross-sectional research highlights the benefits of course-related humour, longitudinal evidence examining the mediating roles of socio-emotional and motivational factors in student emotions and motivation remains unexplored. Hence, this study examines how different types of perceived teacher humour are associated with student emotions and intrinsic motivation through teacher-student relationship and the interestingness of instruction in a longitudinal mediation framework. A sample of 1,273 9th-grade students (52.1% female; M age : 14.30 years; SD = .52) from 63 secondary school classes participated in this study. Data were collected across three measurement points during one school year. Two-level structural equation modelling evaluated the prospective effects from teacher humour types at Time 1, mediated through teacher-student relationship and interestingness of instruction at Time 2, on emotional and motivational outcomes at Time 3. Multilevel results indicated that course-related and self-disparaging humour were associated with more positive teacher-student relationship and enjoyment, while course-unrelated and aggressive humour were associated with less positive teacher-student relationship and higher levels of negative emotions. Both instructional features served as mediators of the associations between teacher humour and students' emotions and intrinsic motivation. These findings underscore the importance of course-related and self-disparaging humour as potential sources for supporting positive socio-emotional and motivational learning environments, while highlighting the risks of unrelated and aggressive humour. Practical implications regarding the functionality and application of different forms of teacher humour are also discussed.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Mediation; Developmental psychology; Longitudinal study; Social psychology; Structural equation modeling; Multilevel model; Positive relationship; Sample
articles.summary: 本研究通过纵向调查考察了教师幽默类型对学生情绪和动机的影响，发现课程相关和自嘲型幽默能通过促进积极的师生关系和教学趣味性，提升学生享受和内在动机；而无关和攻击性幽默则导致负面情绪增加，师生关系恶化。

articles.title: Group and personal need satisfaction in Black Lives Matter activism during the COVID-19 pandemic
articles.authors: Ben Thomas, Anne Holding, Élodie C. Audet, Richard Koestner, Xiaoyan Fang
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: A significant proportion of the worldwide population is at risk of social isolation and loneliness as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic. We aimed to identify effective interventions to reduce social isolation and loneliness that are compatible with COVID-19 shielding and social distancing measures. METHODS AND FINDINGS: In this rapid systematic review, we searched six electronic databases (Medline, Embase, Web of Science, PsycINFO, Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews and SCOPUS) from inception to April 2020 for systematic reviews appraising interventions for loneliness and/or social isolation. Primary studies from those reviews were eligible if they included: 1) participants in a non-hospital setting; 2) interventions to reduce social isolation and/or loneliness that would be feasible during COVID-19 shielding measures; 3) a relevant control group; and 4) quantitative measures of social isolation, social support or loneliness. At least two authors independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias using the Downs and Black checklist. Study registration: PROSPERO CRD42020178654. We identified 45 RCTs and 13 non-randomised controlled trials; none were conducted during the COVID-19 pandemic. The nature, type, and potential effectiveness of interventions varied greatly. Effective interventions for loneliness include psychological therapies such as mindfulness, lessons on friendship, robotic pets, and social facilitation software. Few interventions improved social isolation. Overall, 37 of 58 studies were of "Fair" quality, as measured by the Downs & Black checklist. The main study limitations identified were the inclusion of studies of variable quality; the applicability of our findings to the entire population; and the current poor understanding of the types of loneliness and isolation experienced by different groups affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. CONCLUSIONS: Many effective interventions involved cognitive or educational components, or facilitated communication between peers. These interventions may require minor modifications to align with COVID-19 shielding/social distancing measures. Future high-quality randomised controlled trials conducted under shielding/social distancing constraints are urgently needed.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Social psychology; Life satisfaction; Pandemic; Multilevel model; Well-being; Coronavirus disease 2019; Developmental psychology; Personal development; Just-world hypothesis
articles.summary: 本研究通过系统综述评估了COVID-19期间减少社会孤立和孤独感的有效干预措施。发现正念疗法、友谊课程、机器人宠物和社交软件等对孤独感有效，但改善社会孤立的干预较少。干预措施多涉及认知或教育成分，或促进同伴沟通，可能需要微调以适应防疫要求。

articles.title: Disgust learning and memory generalization across category exemplars and learning contexts
articles.abstract: The role of emotions in adult learning and achievement has received increasing attention in recent years. However, much of the emphasis has been on test anxiety, rather than the wider spectrum of negative emotions such as sadness, grief, boredom and anger. This paper reports findings of a qualitative study exploring the experience and functionality of negative emotions at university. Thirty-six academic staff and students from an Australian university were interviewed about emotional responses to a range of learning events. Data analysis was informed by a prototype approach to emotion research. Four categories of discrete negative emotions (anger, sadness, fear, boredom) were considered by teachers and students to be especially salient in learning, with self-conscious emotions (guilt, embarrassment, shame) mentioned by more students than staff. While negative emotions were frequently viewed as detrimental to motivation, performance and learning, they were also construed under some circumstances as beneficial. The findings are discussed in relation to the value of social functional approaches for a better understanding of the diverse roles of negative emotions in learning and achievement.
articles.keywords: Disgust; Psychology; Generalization; Cognitive psychology; Social psychology; Memoria; Developmental psychology; Cognitive science; Cognition
articles.summary: 本研究采用质性方法，探讨了大学学习中负面情绪的体验与功能。研究发现，愤怒、悲伤、恐惧、厌倦等情绪在学习中尤为突出，而内疚、尴尬等自我意识情绪则更多由学生提及。负面情绪虽常被视为有害，但在特定情境下也能发挥积极作用，强调了社会功能视角的重要性。

articles.title: Let creativity flow: Are flow states linked to enhanced creative performance?
articles.authors: Birte A. K. Thissen, Gabriele Oettingen
articles.journal: Psychology of Aesthetics, Creativity, and the Arts
articles.publish_info: Psychology of Aesthetics, Creativity, and the Arts, 2026-06-29
articles.abstract: Flow, an inherently rewarding state of mind characterized by complete task engagement, has been frequently observed in the context of creative activities, yet its relationship to creativity is still underresearched. To test whether creative performance and flow are positively related, we had N = 119 students complete the Abbreviated Torrance Test for Adults and report on their flow during the writing and drawing tasks involved in this creativity test. Spearman correlations showed no significant associations between flow and creativity test scores, neither for the composite score nor for its creative abilities subscores. However, we found a positive association between flow and self-rated performance, which was, in turn, unrelated to creativity test scores. This pattern of null-associations with test scores yet positive associations with self-rated performance was confirmed in multiple regression analyses, taking participants' creative dispositions into account, and in correlations with flow subscores, representing various experiential phenomena that cumulate in the flow state. Thus, our findings suggest that flow is primarily linked to better self-rated, not externally rated creative performances. Overall, the flow-performance relationship appears to be more nuanced in the creative domain than in other activity domains and may unfold mostly on an experiential level.
articles.keywords: Creativity; Psychology; Flow; Cognitive psychology; Cognitive science; Social psychology; Aesthetics; Perception; Creativity technique; Ideation
articles.summary: 本研究探讨心流状态与创造性表现的关系，通过创造力测试和自我报告方法，发现心流与客观测试分数无显著关联，但与自我评价表现正相关，表明心流主要影响主观感知而非客观创造性产出。

articles.title: Outgroup friendships and social influence in the development of adolescent attitudes toward secondary outgroups.
articles.authors: Tibor Zingora, Chloe Bracegirdle, Tobias H. Stark, Olivia Spiegler
articles.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
articles.publish_info: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2026-06-29
articles.abstract: Having outgroup friends not only improves attitudes toward the (primary) outgroup but potentially also toward other (secondary) outgroups. This "secondary transfer effect" is attributed to the generalization of intergroup contact, but it may also reflect social influence as friends shape each other's outgroup attitudes. In three studies (two empirical and one simulation), we applied stochastic actor-oriented models to longitudinal network data representing friendships between adolescents. Across Studies 1 (n = 812) and 2 (n = 2,559), we found no evidence that having more primary outgroup friends was associated with a change in secondary outgroup attitudes; instead, adolescents' attitudes became more similar over time to those of their primary outgroup friends. Study 3, a simulation, further showed that social influence can lead to either more positive or more negative attitudes toward secondary outgroups. Thus, friendships with primary outgroup members may have negative implications for secondary outgroups when those friends hold more negative attitudes. We discuss how social influence can advance research on the generalization of intergroup contact effects.
articles.keywords: Outgroup; Psychology; Social psychology; Ingroups and outgroups; Developmental psychology; Generalization; Prosocial behavior; Social influence; Social identity theory; Social relation
articles.summary: 本研究采用随机行动者导向模型分析青少年纵向友谊网络数据，发现拥有外群体朋友主要通过社会影响使青少年态度与朋友趋同，而非直接改变对次要外群体的态度；模拟研究表明，朋友态度的消极性可能导致对次要外群体的态度泛化更负面。

articles.title: Executive function and social behavior: Causal evidence from loading working memory and inhibitory control.
articles.authors: Mahsa Barzy, Yicheng Qiu, Heather J. Ferguson
articles.abstract: This article investigates how domain-specific executive functions contribute to perspective-taking and prosocial behavior. Across two preregistered experiments, we independently manipulated working memory (WM) and inhibitory control to assess their effects on social cognition. In Experiment 1 (N = 128), WM load was varied using a dual-task paradigm, and participants completed behavioral and eye-tracking measures of perspective-taking and prosociality. WM load impaired perspective-taking, and this effect was larger under nonsocial than social load. Conversely, individual differences in prosocial behavior were associated with higher social (but not nonsocial) WM capacity and larger support cliques, suggesting that dissociable cognitive mechanisms underpin different social outcomes. Notably, WM performance did not vary across social versus nonsocial conditions, indicating that increased social complexity did not impair WM and that the relationship is not bidirectional. In Experiment 2 (N = 122), inhibitory control was manipulated using an ego-depletion task, but no significant effects of load emerged. We discuss the challenges of isolating inhibitory control from WM and highlight the need for improved methods in future research. Overall, these findings provide causal evidence linking WM to social skills, underscore the importance of distinguishing between social and nonsocial domains of executive functioning, and point to key conceptual and methodological priorities for the field.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Working memory; Inhibitory control; Cognitive psychology; Executive functions; Function; Control; Cognition; Short-term memory; Attentional control
articles.summary: 本研究通过实验操纵工作记忆和抑制控制，考察其对社会认知中视角采纳和亲社会行为的影响。发现工作记忆负载损害视角采纳，且在社会负载下效应较小；亲社会行为与社会工作记忆容量相关。抑制控制操纵未发现显著效应，研究强调了区分社会与非社会执行功能的重要性。

articles.title: Bridging space and time in relational memory: enhanced integration of spatiotemporal contextual associations by emotion.
articles.authors: Jacob S Faibishenko, Paul C Bogdan, Sanda Dolcos, Florin Dolcos
articles.abstract: Prior research has primarily investigated the effects of emotion on spatial and temporal associations separately. Here, we jointly examined the influence of negative arousal on both types of associations to provide a more comprehensive understanding of emotion's impact on episodic memory. During encoding, participants (N = 133) viewed a series of images involving dissociable foreground and background components and were encouraged to make temporal contextual associations between consecutive images. Subsequently, participants' relational memory (RM) was tested using a retrieval task that assessed: (1) subjective RM (recollection-based), (2) objective spatial RM (foreground-background matches), along with the link between subjective and objective RM accuracy (Double-Hit), and (3) temporal RM (sequential associations) and accuracy in the spatiotemporal associations (Triple-Hit). First, replicating and extending earlier evidence, emotion enhanced subjective recollection confirmed by objective spatial RM (Double-Hit). Second, we also present novel evidence that emotion enhances spatiotemporal integration - i.e. emotion enhanced subjective and spatial objective RM, while also upregulating associations with subsequent neutral information (Triple-Hit). These findings promote a broader understanding of emotion's impact on episodic memory and lay the foundation for developing interventions aimed at improving memory for contextual associations in healthy functioning and reducing memory decontextualization associated with PTSD and age-related cognitive decline.
articles.keywords: Arousal; Associative Memory; Memory Decontextualization; Spatiotemporal Context; Temporal Bias
articles.summary: 本研究考察了负性唤醒情绪对关系记忆中时空上下文关联的影响。实验发现情绪不仅增强了基于回忆的主观记忆和空间记忆准确性，还促进了与后续中性信息的时空整合，从而深化了对情绪在情景记忆中作用的理解。

articles.title: Investigating the effect of post-retrieval imagery rescripting on the reinstatement of generalised fear.
articles.abstract: Post-retrieval extinction has been proposed to modify fear memories by introducing safety information during the reconsolidation window. Imagery rescripting (ImRS) is a visual imagery-based intervention that alters the valence of emotional memories through UCS revaluation. The integration of ImRS and extinction targets both UCS revaluation and expectancy revaluation, providing a dual mechanism for fear reduction. This study explores the combined effects of imagery rescripting (ImRS) and extinction during the reconsolidation window to attenuate the return of generalised fear. Sixty-one healthy individuals underwent fear acquisition and generalisation (Day 1), followed by intervention (Day 2: Reactivation- ImRS and Extinction group or ImRS and Extinction group). On Day 3, return of generalised fear through reinstatement was tested using unsignalled UCS presentations. Skin conductance responses (SCR), expectancy ratings, and valence ratings were the outcome measures. The reactivation-ImRS + extinction group showed reduced reinstatement effects compared to the ImRS + extinction group, evidenced by attenuated SCR and increased CS+ valence ratings. The current study suggests that imagery rescripting and extinction conducted post-retrieval is more effective in reducing the return of conditioned fear. Therefore, integrating ImRS with post-retrieval extinction may offer a novel therapeutic pathway for reducing fear relapse.
articles.keywords: Fear generalisation; imagery rescripting; post-retrieval extinction; reinstatement; skin conductance responses
articles.summary: 本研究探讨了在消退窗口期结合意象重写和消退干预对恐惧普遍化恢复的影响。通过皮肤电反应等指标发现，反应化-意象重写联合消退能更有效地减少恐惧恢复，为预防恐惧复发提供了新的潜在治疗方法。

articles.title: New insights on the illusory truth effect: societal reach, cognitive foundations, and mitigation strategies
articles.abstract: Decades of research show that repeated information is more believed than new information - an "illusory truth effect". This article integrates past and recent research to examine its broader social consequences. Findings indicate that repetition strengthens stereotypical beliefs about social groups and reduces moral condemnation. Moreover, the effect extends beyond message content: communicators conveying repeated messages gain credibility. Turning to underlying mechanisms, the review shows that simply knowing that information has been repeated can increase its perceived truthfulness, suggesting repetition acts as a learned cue for truth. Nonetheless, people underestimate the influence of repetition on beliefs, particularly on themselves. Importantly, the article identifies a key boundary condition: changing the informational ecology from affirmation to interrogation substantially weakens the effect. Together, these findings position repetition as a powerful force in belief formation and clarify the origins and the limits of repetition-induced truth. Implications within and beyond the illusory truth literature are discussed.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Cognition; Social psychology; Cognitive psychology; Motivated reasoning; Social cognition; Cognitive bias; Social cognitive theory
articles.summary: 本研究整合了重复信息对信念形成的影响，发现重复能增强对社会群体的刻板信念并降低道德谴责，同时重复也能提升沟通者的可信度。重复通过作为真实性学习线索的机制发挥作用，但人们低估了其对信念的影响，尤其是对自身信念的影响；改变信息环境从肯定转向审问可显著减弱该效应。

articles.title: Hyperbaric oxygen intervention enhances cooperative gains in high-trust people at high-altitude: the role of medial prefrontal inter-brain synchrony.
articles.authors: Yuan Yong, Yiyue Bai, Huanhuan Jing, Si Yang, Xinyu Pei, Jinxia Cheng, Hao Li, Hailin Ma, Niannian Wang
articles.abstract: Successful cooperation requires the efficient integration of self and other-related information. Whether hyperbaric oxygen intervention improves cooperative performance under high-altitude hypoxic conditions, and whether such effects depend on interpersonal neural coordination, remains unclear. In this randomized crossover study, 62 dyads completed a cooperative task under both hyperbaric oxygen intervention and high-altitude hypoxic conditions while undergoing fNIRS hyperscanning. We examined whether hyperbaric oxygen intervention enhanced cooperative performance and whether this effect was associated with interpersonal trust and inter-brain synchrony (IBS). High-trust dyads exhibited greater hyperbaric-oxygen-related cooperation gains. Increases in medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) IBS predicted improvements in cooperation success rate and cooperation efficiency, and both associations were moderated by interpersonal trust: positive associations were observed only in high-trust dyads. Pseudo-dyad analyses further indicated that this effect reflected real interpersonal interaction rather than shared task structure. These findings suggest that the cooperative benefits of hyperbaric oxygen intervention are not uniform, but depend on interpersonal relationship quality. mPFC IBS may constitute an important neural correlate of hyperbaric-oxygen-related cooperation gains in high-trust dyads.
articles.keywords: cooperation; fNIRS hyperscanning; high-altitude hypoxia; hyperbaric oxygen intervention; medial prefrontal cortex; trust
articles.summary: 本研究利用fNIRS超扫描技术探讨了高压氧干预在高海拔条件下对合作表现的影响及其神经机制。发现高压氧干预能显著提升高信任配对的合作收益，内侧前额叶皮层间的同步性与合作成功率和效率的提高相关，且这种关联仅在高信任配对中显著。研究表明，高压氧干预的合作效益依赖于人际关系质量，内侧前额叶皮层间同步性可能是高信任配对神经协调的重要基础。

articles.title: Emotional Closeness With Friends Is Associated With Sociodemographic Similarity and Personality Traits
articles.journal: Journal of Social and Personal Relationships
articles.publish_info: Journal of Social and Personal Relationships, 2026-07-04
articles.abstract: The Similarity-Attraction hypothesis suggests that people tend to like others who are more similar to them. Friends tend to resemble each other, but it is unknown whether the greater resemblance leads to greater friendship quality. This association might also depend on the person's personality traits, which have been associated with differences in friendship patterns. The current study examined whether similarity in four sociodemographic characteristics (age, sex, marital status, and parenthood status) between friends, and the personality traits of the participant (extraversion, emotional stability, agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness to experience), were associated with higher emotional closeness with friends, as reported by the participant. Data were from the German Panel Analysis of Intimate Relationships and Family Dynamics (pairfam; n = 7,699 participants who reported relationship information on 44,199 of their friends across two study waves). We used fixed-effect multilevel regression models to examine associations between sociodemographic similarity and emotional closeness based on within-participant variation across different friends of the participant. Higher sociodemographic similarity was associated with higher emotional closeness, more strongly for women than men. Higher extraversion, agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness to experience of the participant were associated with higher emotional closeness, and the associations of conscientiousness and openness to experience were amplified by higher friend similarity. Most of these associations between personality and friendship emotional closeness were small in magnitude. The findings extend the Similarity-Attraction hypothesis by showing that friend similarity is related to higher emotional closeness.
articles.keywords: Closeness; Psychology; Openness to experience; Friendship; Similarity; Big Five personality traits; Personality; Conscientiousness; Association
articles.summary: 本研究基于相似-吸引假设，考察朋友间社会人口学相似性及参与者人格特质与情感亲密度的关联。利用德国pairfam面板数据，通过固定效应多层次回归模型分析发现，社会人口学相似性越高，情感亲密度越强，且该效应在女性中更显著；参与者的外向性、宜人性、尽责性和开放性等特质也与更高的情感亲密度相关。

articles.title: Does Testosterone Affect Cognitive Reflection? Evidence From a Double-Blind, Randomized Controlled Study of 1,000 Participants.
articles.authors: Erik L Knight, Gideon Nave, Steven D Shaw, Coren Apicella, Pierre L Bonin, Anna Dreber, Shawn N Geniole, Magnus Johannesson, Dylan Manfredi, Pranjal Mehta, Valentina Proietti, Steven J Stanton, Francesca R Luberti, Triana Ortiz, Justin M Carré
articles.abstract: The cognitive reflection test (CRT) measures reliance on intuitive thinking versus deliberate reasoning and predicts important real-world outcomes. Prior research has suggested that testosterone administration impaired CRT performance, but follow-up studies produced null results. To provide a rigorous test, we conducted a large, preregistered, double-blind, placebo-controlled experiment, unprecedented in size, with 1,000 adult men, as part of an adversarial collaboration. Participants received a single dose of intranasal testosterone or placebo, completed the CRT, and rated their confidence level. We found an insignificant treatment effect on the CRT, with the point estimate in the opposite direction of the original hypothesis (βLOGIT = 0.118, 95% confidence interval (CI) = [-0.099, 0.335]). In a second primary test, we found a significant negative treatment effect on confidence (βLOGIT = -0.329, 95% CI = [-0.558, -0.100]), which is also the opposite of our prediction. Our findings challenge earlier claims about testosterone's cognitive effects and highlight the importance of high-powered replications. Long-term or developmental testosterone effects remain potentially important but difficult to study.
articles.keywords: cognitive reflection; experiment; hormones; overconfidence; randomized trial; testosterone
articles.summary: 本研究通过一项大型双盲随机对照试验，考察了睾酮对认知反思的影响。结果显示，单次鼻内给予睾酮对认知反思测试的表现无显著影响，但显著降低了参与者的自信心水平，这与原有假设相反。研究挑战了先前关于睾酮认知效应的声称，并强调了高功效复制的重要性。
